agyos_skill.intent: Server management principles and decision-making. Process management, monitoring strategy, and scaling decisions. Teaches thinking, not commands.
agyos_skill.instructions: > Server management principles for production operations. > **Learn to THINK, not memorize commands.** | Scenario | Tool | |----------|------| | **Node.js app** | PM2 (clustering, reload) | | **Any app** | systemd (Linux native) | | **Containers** | Docker/Podman | | **Orchestration** | Kubernetes, Docker Swarm | | Goal | What It Means | |------|---------------| | **Restart on crash** | Auto-recovery | | **Zero-downtime reload** | No service interruption | | **Clustering** | Use all CPU cores | | **Persistence** | Survive server reboot | | Category | Key Metrics | |----------|-------------| | **Availability** | Uptime, health checks | | **Performance** | Response time, throughput | | **Errors** | Error rate, types | | **Resources** | CPU, memory, disk | | Level | Response | |-------|----------| | **Critical** | Immediate action | | **Warning** | Investigate soon | | **Info** | Review daily |
